title: Normalized affine cohomology section identifications independent of the resolution lift
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let $g:S'\to S$ and $g'=\operatorname{pullback.snd}(g,f)$ be flat, and let $F$ be a quasi-coherent module. Cohomology $H^p_{\mathrm{mod}}$ means right-derived global sections in module sheaves [pqf-def-cohomology]. Take injective resolutions $I$ of $F$ and $J$ of $g'^*F$, affine opens $V\subset S$, $W\subset S'$ with $W\subset g^{-1}V$, and specified restricted resolution data $D$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Put $A=\Gamma(S,V)$, $B=\Gamma(S',W)$ with the algebra structure from $g$, $U=f^{-1}V$, $h:U\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ the restriction of $f$ followed by the affine chart, and $N=F|_U$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $P=R^pf_*F$ and $Q=R^p(\operatorname{pullback.fst}(g,f))_*g'^*F$. The specified classes $D.\mathrm{sourceClass}$ and $D.\mathrm{targetClass}$ are those of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction]. There exist an additive equivalence $e_H:H^p_{\mathrm{mod}}(U,F|_U)\simeq HOver(h,N,p)$, a bijective $B$-linear map $a:B\otimes_A HOver(h,N,p)\to\Gamma(W,g^*P)$, and a bijective $B$-linear map $b:HOver(h_B,N_B,p)\to\Gamma(W,Q)$ [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], such that $a(s\otimes\xi)=s\cdot(\eta_P(D.\mathrm{sourceClass}(e_H^{-1}\xi)))|_W$ and $b(H.\mathrm{baseChangeLinear}(\xi))=(D.\mathrm{targetClass}(H^p_{\mathrm{mod}}(g'|_U,D.\psi)(e_H^{-1}\xi)))|_W$ [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Here $h_B,N_B$ are the canonical base-changed scheme morphism and module, and $\eta$ is the specified tensor-pullback adjunction unit. Neither a resolution lift nor the morphism flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta occurs in this assertion.
